reviews.x: It looks exactly  like the picture you just need to wet it I wash every wig I get before wear them but the pics I posted is with a little water and oil sheen and only other complaint is that the under tangles alot and its a little thick and bulky and wish the part was deeper but again for the money no complaints but its soft no sheading and it's thickness is just like the picture I wasn't going to post any pics or a review but truly one of the better wigs I have gotten actually amazon is the bes

reviews.t: Hair itself is nice but the part in the front is trash
reviews.x: So the hair itself is very pretty for synthetic hair. Its soft and flowy and comes with 3 combs inside. The only issue, which is a big one to me, is the fact that the part looks plasticky and you can just tell it's fake. With a head band it looks fine but if u want something that resembles a lace front wig this isnt it. Idk where the people in the other reviews got they hair from...the seller must have switched their product or something idk

[[VIDEOID:16b42f44667618d37566e4e74a1bd3bc]] I kept looking at the reviews and some were bad some were good but I’m glad I did order this wig. It was a last minute thing because my birthday was coming up but in person it’s really soft and long length like I like them and it didn’t come out the package all messed up. But yes it does have a bad smell to it. I definitely recommend u pay for this at your own risk.

My first thoughts after opening the package is this wig looks extra frizzy and used. Pros: Thick and ve ry soft Cons: Too Frizzy for a new wig.  Some of the wave/curl pattern are straight and flat. There wasn't a cohesive wave/curl pattern that is found in new wigs. Overall it has potential to be an amazing wig therefore I would recommend it. Hopefully it arrives in better condition.

[[VIDEOID:8c4ce614c77bee6aad271001bae87afb]] DOESNT LOOK LIKE PHOTO NOT LACE. its good for the price but just expect a silicone scalp like party city value. You can press out the hair and recurl it on 340°F. I've had it in for a week and its holding up fine. Don't brush too much you may experience shedding. Don't overpluck hairline or you will see the gray silicone underneath.

Before I even put the wig on I fell in love with it. I put it on and I felt wonderful in it. It is soft and fluffy and looks like my hair. I went to dinner in it the night I received it. Please be careful during your selection to get truly what you want...if you want lace be certain to read the description.  I like my unit and will purchase again from this Seller.

reviews.t: High quality at a great price
reviews.x: I absolutely love this wig!  It exceeded my expectations.  I  will be ordering another one.  It is very soft like human hair.  It's not stiff like some synthetic wigs, and it is light and airy on my scalp. The shedding was very minimal.  I will be wearing this look for a long time.

[[VIDEOID:94947dbe5a6e43c7b5e9765780ee034f]] I honestly love how real and soft this hair is. It is so easy to work with and the wet look is amazing. It does tangle a little but slips out easily with water and a leave in. Best wig of my life. I will continue to be a customer!!!

The wig was basically as you saw online, love the soft texture and length. A little thick on the front part but I tweaked it with my own little touch. Came just in time my occasion this weekend. Would definitely recommend.

For the price, this wig really impresses! Just needs a little combing every few hours. I looked at wigs for days on here, got overwhelmed and decided to buy one that I wouldn't feel guilty about. I am glad I got this one!

reviews.t: Good quality wig for a great price
reviews.x: I love love love this wig !!! It's long, curly, bouncy, three combs that are comfortable , has a good natural middle part. The wig is synthetic but I love love love it. I will be buying from this company again

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the hair as soft, with many calling it very soft or like human hair.
Many customers consider it a great value for the price, though some note it is synthetic and not human hair.
Several reviewers note the wig is thick and full, which some like but others find bulky or too thick at the hairline.
A common complaint is that it is not a lace front and the part looks fake or plasticky.
Tangling and shedding are mentioned by some reviewers, though experiences vary.
